_meta.comment: Hand-curated replies from Buttondown emails. Keyed by post path (category/slug), same entry shape as interactions-index.json but platform is always "email". Buttondown exposes no reply API and email is private by default, so entries are pasted in manually — that's also the consent checkpoint. Reduce the author name to a first name unless the sender gave permission to use more. Merged into the site at build time by src/utils/interactions.ts; never touched by the collector script.
